items.title: Management of solar panel factory transferred to private company
items.summary: Maputo, 22 Oct (AIM) – The Mozambican government has decided to transfer the management of Beluluane solar panel factory, which was managed by the country’s Energy Fund (FUNAE), to the Emirati Company Jampur Group. According to FUNAE chairman, Mety Gondola, the measure is aimed at modernizing the factory, which is located in Boane district, southern province of Maputo. The measure will also increase the capacity to supply equipment for the electrification of communities, particularly in rural areas. The management transfer was formalized on Wednesday through the signing of an agreement between the FUNAE and Jampur Group. Gondola explained that the decision to transfer management to the private sector stems, among other factors, from technological limitations that have constrained the industrial unit’s production capacity and competitiveness.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia trade strikes after Witkoff talks
items.summary: Soon after Putin and Zelenskyy expressed willingness to resume US-mediated talks, Russia and Ukraine traded major attacks on each other's capitals Russia and Ukraine traded major attacks overnight, authorities from both countries said on Thursday, shortly after US envoy Steve Witkoff held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg Missiles struck Kyiv in the early hours of Thursday, wounding at least 15 people, eight of whom have been hospitalized, city authorities said The subway infrastructure on the Southern Bridge over the Dnipro river in Kyiv was also damaged, Mayor ⁠Vitali ​Klitschko ​said ​on Telegram "Overnight, Kyiv residents heard what Russian 'humanism' truly sounds like: a brutal attack with dozens of ballistic missiles striking energy infrastructure, medical facilities, shopping centers, and residential Areas," Ukrainian foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on social media His post referred to Witkoff recently calling Putin a "humanitarian" for freeing US citizen Stephen Hubbard on Wednesday.

items.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
items.summary: For more than a decade, serious flaws had gone undetected in the technology underpinning much of the internet It took artificial intelligence (AI) to bring them to light and caused a global cyber-security alert The vulnerabilities lie within a programming language called PHP, which has been used internationally since the 2000s to build websites Governments and cyber-security agencies around the world are scrambling to contain the fallout of the discovery on Wednesday, and have urged website operators to install a new emergency fix or consider taking their platforms offline Cyber-security firm Wiz - one of the companies whose researchers uncovered the vulnerabilities - described the flaws as the "most severe" ever detected by AI OpenAI, whose technology was used to find the flaws, called the discovery "one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory" Most people may not have heard of PHP, but they probably interact with it daily Short for PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor, it powers a vast number of platforms, including online shops, Wikipedia and WordPress – the content…

items.title: Mozambique: Chapo announces 20% state stake in mining projects through new state-owned company
items.summary: In his opening speech at the CAVAME-d 2026 conference, Chapo said that the creation of the state-owned Empresa Nacional de Minas, amendments to the Mining Law and the Petroleum Law, and the Local Content Law form part of the government’s new economic direction According to the President, the legal instruments were approved by the Assembly of the Republic, and their respective regulations were approved by the Council of Ministers last week Shareholding does not mean guaranteed revenue The state’s presence in the capital of mining projects could allow it to participate directly in the economic results of the ventures, in addition to the taxes and fees levied on mining activities The model nevertheless requires management and financing capacity. An equity stake may entail financial responsibilities and exposure to investment risks A 20% stake also does not mean that the state automatically receives that proportion of the value of production.

items.title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
items.summary: Students in Nazareth are handing out leaflets encouraging Arab Israelis to vote in next week's election At rush hour in Nazareth, the largest Arab-majority city in Israel, students are handing out leaflets by the roadside urging motorists to vote in next week's closely fought, general election. Polls indicate that Arab parties could be left holding a critical balance of power Disaffection has often driven down past turnout among Arab Israelis - who account for about a fifth of the population and often describe themselves as Palestinian citizens of Israel. But this election, there is a strong push to get rid of the most right-wing governing coalition in the country's history - an alliance between veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties "I see it as our duty to bring down this extremist government. They treat us as second-class," says Arkan Badran, 23, who is with the students giving out flyers.

items.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say
items.summary: Ameth Bek Hospital in Abyei town has been treating people wounded in Monday's attack on the market Sudan's army has been accused of launching several drone strikes that have reportedly killed more than 300 people, including dozens travelling to a funeral The death toll from strikes in two areas of West Kordofan state on Sunday evening was 150, sources told the Sudan War Observatory, which tracks the conflict that erupted in 2023 between the army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) In Abyei, a disputed border area between Sudan and South Sudan, 153 people were killed when drones hit a market on Monday, the region's information minister said A military source told the BBC the army had carried out the Abyei attack, saying the market was a fuel supply site for the RSF The attack has raised tensions between South Sudan and Sudan, which jointly administer Abyei, as they both claim ownership to the oil-rich region in a dispute that has remained unresolved since South Sudan ceded in 2011 South Sudan has summoned Sudan's ambassador to lodge a formal protest.

items.title: Is Ebola under control in Kenya after nine cases confirmed?
items.summary: Nearly 5,000 healthcare workers have been trained to deal with Ebola Kenya is grappling with its first ever outbreak of Ebola, a disease which neighbouring countries, such as Uganda and Democratic Republic of Congo, are used to dealing with Nine cases have now been confirmed including its first patient, who travelled from DR Congo and died two weeks ago Four relatives of the first victim, three health workers and a hospital cleaner have now tested positive, meaning they are all linked to him But concerns are rising that the virus could start spreading further, even as the government has sought to assure citizens The US has warned it citizens against travelling to Kenya, while neighbouring countries such as Uganda, Ethiopia and Somalia are also on alert Kenyans have been expressing their concerns that the disease could spread more widely More than 4,000 people have died since Ebola was confirmed in DR Congo in May, making it the second most deadly outbreak of the disease With more than 9,500 cases in DR Congo, Kenya faces a steady risk of new cases arriving across borders, according…
